inspection_policy: Resolve official-index-snapshot INSPECT decisions from preserved Raw HTML only; do not promote organization/project claims to independently reproduced facts.

resolutions.reason: CiA describes CAN XL as the third CAN data-link generation, intended for backbone/sub-backbone use and standardized in ISO 11898-1:2024; this is directly relevant to the coexistence of Ethernet and evolving CAN roles.
verification_targets: Verify ISO 11898-1:2024 standardization identity and publication chronology.
Verify CAN XL payload, bit-rate statements, backbone/sub-backbone positioning and TCP/IP integration wording from primary material.

resolutions.reason: The page records consortium chronology such as the SDV Alliance launch and VSS alignment activity, but is a broad annual highlights post rather than a focused technical artifact.
verification_targets: Use only for dated ecosystem/consortium chronology that cannot be better established from the underlying initiative pages.
Do not treat annual-highlight language as independent evidence of technical adoption.

resolutions.reason: COVESA explains vSomeIP's relationship to AUTOSAR SOME/IP, its BMW-originated open implementation lineage, and its complementarity with VSS for service/data interoperability.
verification_targets: Verify project lineage, maintainer roles, AUTOSAR SOME/IP relationship and supported implementation scope.
Separate COVESA interoperability claims from independently established production deployment.

resolutions.reason: The Eclipse Foundation launch announcement defines S-CORE as an open core stack for embedded high-performance ECUs and describes a safety-oriented development process aimed at ISO 26262-suitable software.
verification_targets: Verify launch date, initial release/maturity claims, target ECU/platform scope and governance/contributor facts.
Treat safety suitability/certification language as organization/project claims unless independently established.

resolutions.reason: The current S-CORE project page describes a common safety-critical runtime foundation and explicit release-gate/maturity expectations for requirements, architecture documentation and safety artifacts.
verification_targets: Verify current release-gate chronology against versioned release artifacts within the coverage cutoff.
Verify module maturity/safety process semantics without back-projecting post-cutoff page updates into earlier events.

resolutions.reason: IEEE 802.1 records IEEE Std 802.1DG-2025 as published and defines an automotive in-vehicle Ethernet TSN profile covering deterministic latency, reliability, availability and security requirements.
verification_targets: Verify board approval/publication dates and exact standard identity.
Verify scope of the automotive TSN profile and referenced TSN/security standards.

resolutions.reason: OPEN Alliance TC14 provides a concrete automotive 10BASE-T1S specification/interoperability roadmap including PLCA, diagnostics, topology discovery, sleep/wake, EMC and multidrop-MACsec work.
verification_targets: Verify specification versions/dates that fall within the coverage window.
Verify which artifacts are approved versus in progress and avoid treating roadmap targets as completed standards.

resolutions.reason: OPEN Alliance TC9 documents automotive Ethernet cabling/channel requirements across IEEE 802.3 speed grades and current work on coaxial 1000BASE-T1 and 25GBASE-T1.
verification_targets: Verify approved specification versions/dates in the coverage window.
Separate published channel/component requirements from work-in-progress focus areas.

resolutions.reason: The SOAFEE/DENSO blueprint explicitly links cloud-native development parity, deterministic execution and mixed-critical orchestration for SDV middleware.
verification_targets: Verify deterministic execution mechanism, Lingua Franca usage, mixed-critical orchestration design and deployment environment.
Treat guarantee/performance language as DENSO/SOAFEE claims unless independently reproduced.
